en: A black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a rural farming landscape with scattered wooden houses, barns, fields, and surrounding forested hills. The view looks over a valley dotted with small farms and tree-lined roads. In the lower left corner there is printed caption text with a number and place name, and in the lower right corner appears the photographer/publisher logo 'Widerøe'.
